title: SALSA TACO
oneLiner: Catch falling salsa to build the tastiest taco before the kitchen gets too hot!
mechanics: Move the taco left and right beneath falling salsa jars.
Catch salsa to score points and fill your flavor meter.
Avoid falling hot peppers, which cost a life.
Salsa falls faster and gaps tighten over time.

controls.a: Dash briefly in your current direction

lose: Lose all three taco lives after hitting too many hot peppers.
scoring: Each salsa catch scores 10 points, with streak bonuses for consecutive catches.
